confidence.label: Usable
reasons: Packet-size spread meets DeltaQ/BBF targets (64-1444 B, ratio 22.56).

web.label: Web browsing
web.rationale: Browsing is scored under download/upload load (a page load competes with bulk traffic); it tolerates latency up to the CPUP, where page loads become painful rather than merely sluggish.

streaming.label: Video streaming
streaming.rationale: Streaming is throughput- and loss-bound; buffered playback tolerates latency, so the high latency CPUP keeps latency from dominating.

calls.label: Video conferencing
calls.rationale: Calls are interactive: latency and loss are binding constraints, so the worst of them drives the score.

audio.label: Audio calls
audio.rationale: Audio calls have low bandwidth needs but remain latency/loss sensitive, so the worst of those drives the score.

backup.label: Online backup
backup.rationale: Backup is throughput-bound and latency-tolerant; it fails only when latency effectively stalls the transfer.

gaming.label: Real-time gaming
gaming.rationale: Gaming is latency/loss first and rate-capped; bandwidth beyond its floor adds nothing.
